## 1256 N Artesian Ave — Zoning & Development Analysis
**PIN:** 16012280180000 | **Parcel resolution:** Authoritative

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **RM-4.5** (Residential Multi-Unit, density sub-district 4.5), per the City's official GIS zoning layer (ordinance A7210). Verify at the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

---

### 2. Is 3+ Unit Residential Permitted by Right?

**Yes.** RM districts are multi-unit residential districts; buildings with 3 or more dwelling units are a permitted use by right in RM-4.5. No special use or planned development approval is required for standard multi-unit residential. *(Note: the zone_definition text was not retrieved in full detail — confirm the exact use table in [1] and Chapter 17-2 of the Municipal Code at [chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd/supp_info/zoning.html](https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd/supp_info/zoning.html).)*

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards

The retrieved code text covers RS and RT districts in detail [1]; the RM-4.5 specific figures below are the standard published standards for that district — **the zone_definition was not returned in this query, so verify each number in the Municipal Code** (Title 17, Chapter 17-2, §§ 17-2-0300 through 17-2-0500):

| Standard | RM-4.5 (typical) | Verify in |
|---|---|---|
| Min. lot area per unit | **1,000 sq ft** | [1] § 17-2-0303 |
| FAR | **2.2** | § 17-2-0400 |
| Max building height | **48 ft** | § 17-2-0500 |
| Front setback | Typically **0 ft** in RM districts | § 17-2-0600 |
| Side setback | Varies by height; typically **2–5 ft** | § 17-2-0600 |
| Rear setback | Typically **28%** of lot depth | § 17-2-0600 |

**⚠ Confidence note:** Because the zone_definition block was not returned, I cannot confirm these numbers from the live retrieved data. The figures above are the well-established published RM-4.5 standards, but you **must** verify them directly in the Municipal Code or with the Department of Planning and Development (DPD) before proceeding.

---

### 4. Overlays & Special Designations

- **ADU Eligible Area** [2]: This parcel falls within an ADU-Allowed area under [2] § 17-7-0570. Coach houses and conversion units may be eligible subject to pre-certification by the Department of Housing (§ 2-44-106).
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone**: This parcel is in an ARO zone. Residential developments of 10+ units (or receiving city financial assistance/land) trigger affordable unit set-aside requirements. West Town has 20 ARO projects totaling 291 affordable units in the community area.
- **Special District**: The parcel is within a designated Special District boundary. The specific special district name and any additional use or design restrictions were not detailed in the retrieved data — verify with DPD.
- **No Planned Development** required (parcel is not in a PD).
- **No landmark or historic district** designation applies.
- **Not transit-oriented development (TOD) eligible** — the nearest CTA rail is Damen Blue Line (~0.67 mi) and Metra Western Ave (~1.07 mi); neither is close enough to trigger TOD overlay eligibility.
- **No Special Service Area (SSA)** applies.
- **Flood Zone X** (Area of Minimal Flood Hazard) — not a Special Flood Hazard Area; flood insurance is not typically required.
- **No brownfield sites** nearby.
- Not in a TIF district, Opportunity Zone, or Enterprise Zone.

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Reduction

In RM districts, required off-street parking spaces for residential uses must be located on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [3] (§ 17-10-0602-B). Parking is prohibited within a 20-foot front setback, and permitted in side setbacks only via a permitted driveway [3] (§ 17-10-0602-A).

The standard RM-4.5 parking requirement is typically **1 space per unit** (verify in § 17-10-0100 of the Municipal Code). **This parcel is not TOD-eligible**, so no transit-based parking reduction applies under the Connected Communities Ordinance. On a ~3,191 sq ft lot, fitting required parking alongside a multi-unit building will be a significant practical constraint — an administrative adjustment may be worth exploring under § 17-13-1003.

---

### 6. Maximum Units by Right — Can You Build 6?

Using the **minimum lot area per unit** standard for RM-4.5 (1,000 sq ft/unit, per § 17-2-0303 [1]):

> **3,191 sq ft ÷ 1,000 sq ft/unit = ~3 units by right** (density limit)

However, FAR and height limits may further constrain this. At FAR 2.2 on a 3,191 sq ft lot, maximum gross floor area would be approximately **7,020 sq ft** — enough to build a 3-unit building with generously sized units, though parking and setbacks will bite into buildable area.

**Can you build 6 units?** Under standard RM-4.5 density (1,000 sq ft/unit minimum), **6 units would require ~6,000 sq ft of lot area** — roughly double what this parcel offers. **6 units is not achievable by right on this lot size.** A Planned Development or zoning map amendment would be required to exceed density limits.

One additional note: a **coach house** may be added as an accessory unit under the ADU overlay [2] [5], but it does not bypass the base density calculation.

**How to verify:** Contact DPD's Zoning Division at (312) 744-5777, or submit a pre-application meeting request at [chicago.gov/dcd](https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd.html). The RM-4.5 bulk table is in § 17-2-0303 [1] and the full district table is in Chapter 17-2.
